responsibility: Implements GCC’s fixed-point constant-value support layer for FIXED_VALUE_TYPE objects. It handles parsing fixed-point literals from strings, rendering them back to decimal, converting among fixed-point, integer, and real representations, applying saturation or overflow rules according to machine mode IBIT/FBIT layout and signedness, and providing identity/hash/negativity helpers used when building and folding CONST_FIXED values.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable fixed-point conversion, parsing, formatting, saturation, overflow, and sign-testing logic behind FIXED_VALUE_TYPE; unlike gcc/fixed-value.h, it is the implementation of fixed-point semantics rather than the data structure and API declarations.
